skill.name: shopify-store-catalog-and-pricing-extractor
skill.description: Extract public Shopify catalog data through an Apify Actor, including prices, variants, SKUs, images, and availability. Configure filters and export JSON rows.
skill.summary: Export public Shopify catalogs and prices through a documented Apify workflow.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 83 static findings are false positives in context: formatting, example URLs, authorized input reads, configuration access, or documented Apify operations. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized credential disclosure, or malicious execution in the five reviewed files. The remote Actor implementation is absent, so this review does not establish its behavior or data handling.

content.value_statement: Manual collection makes public Shopify pricing and catalog research slow. This skill provides an Apify workflow for configurable extraction into JSON rows.
actual_capabilities: Configure the documented Actor for catalog, collection, product, search, collection directory, or automatic URL detection modes.
Select public storefronts using custom domains, myshopify.com domains, product URLs, or collection URLs.
Configure vendor, product type, tag, price, and availability filters with currency and country settings.
Request product rows with nested variants or separate variant rows, with optional product detail enrichment.
Submit JSON input through the included Node runner and print the synchronous Apify response as formatted JSON.
Follow documented curl commands for asynchronous run creation, status checking, and dataset retrieval.
limitations: Requires an Apify account and token; usage is billed by Apify, and the remote Actor implementation is not included.
Supports public storefront data only, not private, login-protected, or paywalled information.
Search returns at most 10 products per store without pagination; feed offsets and configured row limits can truncate results.
The synchronous API waits up to 300 seconds; the runner requires Node 18 or later and does not directly produce CSV.

use_cases.title: Review Competitor Pricing
use_cases.description: Collect public prices, compare-at prices, and availability from selected stores using consistent currency and country settings.

use_cases.title: Inspect Product Assortments
use_cases.description: Extract selected collections or product types to review vendor coverage, variants, and available SKUs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Catalog Data
use_cases.description: Retrieve JSON datasets with separate variant rows for downstream data processing and spreadsheet conversion.

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Small Catalog
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract up to 50 public products from [store URL] using catalog mode and the store currency. Confirm Apify costs before running.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect a limited first sample.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract collection [handle] from [store URL]. Keep available products priced between [minimum] and [maximum] in [currency], with at most 100 rows.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow the catalog to a relevant assortment.

prompt_templates.title: Export Detailed Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract products from [store URL] with flattenVariants and includeDetails enabled. Limit output to 100 rows and summarize missing SKUs or barcodes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare variant data for downstream review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Asynchronous Multi-Store Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous extraction for [store URLs] with [currency], [country], and [row cap]. Confirm costs, then check run completion before retrieving the dataset.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a larger multi-store export.

best_practices: Start with a 50-row cap and inspect results before approving larger billed runs.
Set consistent currency and country values when comparing prices across stores.
Keep tokens in environment variables and submit only public storefront inputs permitted by applicable terms and law.
anti_patterns: Submitting cookies, sessions, or private account data to the extraction service.
Treating search results or capped exports as a complete store catalog.
Comparing prices across different currencies or treating availability as guaranteed inventory quantity.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What do I need before running it?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN. The included runner requires Node 18 or later, and Apify bills Actor usage.

faq.question: Can it access private Shopify data?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope is public storefront data, and the instructions prohibit cookies, sessions, and private account data.

faq.question: Can I export individual variants?
faq.answer: Yes. Enable flattenVariants for separate variant rows. Enable includeDetails to request additional detail fields where the storefront exposes them.

faq.question: Does search return every matching product?
faq.answer: No. The documented search endpoint returns at most 10 products per store and has no pagination.

faq.question: Does the runner generate CSV files?
faq.answer: No. The included runner prints JSON. CSV requires a separate conversion or export step.
